title: EPME course eligibility and enrollment requirements
content:
Use these requirements to determine EPME eligibility:

- **EPME3000 / EPME3000AA:** All Marines.
- **EPME4000 / EPME4000AA:** Lance Corporals and above; must complete EPME3000.
- **EPME5000 / EPME5000BA:** Sergeants and above. **Sergeant selects cannot enroll; the Marine must hold the rank of Sergeant or above.**
- **EPME6000 / EPME6000BA:** Staff Sergeant selects and above.
- **EPME5500:** Sergeants; must complete EPME5000BA.
- **EPME6800:** Staff Sergeants and Gunnery Sergeants; must complete EPME6000.

For **EPME5500** and **EPME6800**, request enrollment in MCeLE, attach a command-endorsed **NAVMC 11580**, and meet the applicable physical/body-composition requirements.

If the Marine cannot enroll or recently received a new rank or select grade:

- Contact the **MCeLE Help Desk** to verify the rank or select status reflected in MCTFS and receive enrollment assistance.
- For EPME5500 or EPME6800 seminar enrollment, contact the appropriate **CDET regional point of contact** in MARADMIN 110/26.

Some course work may open in Moodle after enrollment, but enrollment assistance begins with MCeLE.

provenance.description: MCTFS/MOL behavior and the EPME5000 Sergeant-select restriction were confirmed by the user. Course eligibility was adapted from the official CDET program page. EPME5500 and EPME6800 enrollment requirements were adapted from MARADMIN 110/26 and MARADMIN 329/26.
